cards.title: CLI
items: Go 1.22 module github.com/entelecheia/entelecheia: one binary, no server; main.go dispatches through internal/profile
Four commands: intro (ASCII banner), open [alias], links (alias table), version
Color output adapts via profile.SupportsColor; unknown aliases list available ones

cards.title: Link registry
items: 10 sites in internal/profile/profile.go, each with its aliases: home, cv, halla, koica-tiu, rise, staix/bwlb, research, repos, github, linkedin
open defaults to home (youngjoon-lee.com); cv resolves to youngjoon-lee.com/cv/
docs/index.html, served by GitHub Pages from main /docs, meta-refreshes to LinkedIn

cards.title: Identity
items: Profile carries the professor/CAIO identity across halla.ai, jeju.ai, and staixbwlb.com properties
Install via go install github.com/entelecheia/entelecheia@latest or GitHub releases
ci.yml runs go vet, build and test (profile_test.go, main_test.go); release.yaml runs goreleaser on v* tags
